movelist.name: Close Combat
movelist.effect: The user’s Defense and Special Defense are each lowered by -1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Punishment
movelist.effect: Punishment’s Damage Base is raised by +1 for each positive Combat Stage the target has, to a maximum of DB 12.

movelist.name: Feint
movelist.effect: If a foe uses a Move with the Shield Keyword in response to one of your actions, you may activate Feint to cause the triggering Move to Fail. Feint is activated as a Free Action.

movelist.name: Flame Wheel
movelist.effect: Flame Wheel Burns the target on 19+.

abilities.name: Pickup
abilities.effect: You may use Pickup as an Extended Action that requires at least 5 minutes. Roll 1d20, consult the Pickup keyword to figure out what you find!

abilities.name: Iron Fist
abilities.effect: The user increases the Damage Base of the following Moves by +2; Bullet Punch, Comet Punch, Dizzy Punch, Drain Punch, Dynamic Punch, Fire Punch, Meteor Mash, Shadow Punch, Ice Punch, Mach Punch, Mega Punch, Sky Uppercut, Thunder Punch, Focus Punch, Hammer Arm, and Power-Up Punch.

abilities.name: Celebrate
abilities.trigger: The user hits a foe with a damaging attack
abilities.effect: The user may immediately Disengage as a Free Action.
